title: 46 Korean Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Korean for Beginners (Motivation)
description:
Learn 46 essential Korean phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Korean #LearnKorean #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in 한국어, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Korean with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 46 real-life phrases
- 한국어 audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Motivation · 동기
1:22  Wisdom · 지혜
2:45  Inner Peace · 내면의 평화
4:09  Purpose · 목적
5:24  Confidence · 자신감
6:39  Patience · 인내심
7:50  Celebrations & Parties · 축하 및 파티
9:12  Success · 성공

PHRASE LIST

MOTIVATION · 동기
• Make mistakes, then come back stronger - 실수해도 괜찮아, 다시 더 강하게 돌아와  [SIL-su-hae-do GWAEN-chan-a, DA-si deo GAN-kae door-a-wa]
• Your effort counts, even on rough days - 거친 날에도 노력은 분명히 쌓여요  [geo-chin nal-e-do NO-ryeok-eun bun-myeong-hi SSA-yeo-yo]
• Little practice now saves future stress - 지금 조금 연습하면 나중이 편해져요  [ji-geum jo-geum YEON-seup-hae-myeon NA-jung-i pyeon-hae- jyeo-yo]
• Set a tiny goal, start anyway - 작은 목표 하나만 정하고, 일단 시작해요  [ja-geun mok-pyo ha-na-man JEONG-ha-go, IL-dan si-jak-hae-yo]
• Turn Korean into your daily habit - 한국어를 매일 습관처럼 붙여 보세요  [han-guk-eo-reul mae-il seup- gwan-cheo-rom BUT-yeo bo-se-yo]

WISDOM · 지혜
• Choose patience, not quick reactions - 빨리 반응하기보다 인내를 선택해  [Ppalli ban-eunghagi boda inne-reul seontaekhae]
• Pause, then speak what is true - 멈추고, 그다음에 진실만 말해  [Meomuchigo, geu-daeume jinshilman malhae]
• Don’t argue, clarify what you mean - 싸우지 말고, 말하려는 뜻을 분명히 해  [Ssa-uji malgo, mal-lyeo-neun ttus-eul bunmyeonghi hae]
• Make space for silence to teach - 침묵이 가르치게 시간을 내줘  [Chim-muk-i garu-chi-ge sigan-eul nae-jwo]
• Your mind improves with gentle limits - 마음을 달래며 한계를 정해  [Mae-um-eul dallyeomyeo han-gye-reul jeonghae]
• Better ask why, then decide - 왜 그런지 먼저 보고 결정해  [Wae geu-reon-ji meon-jeo bo-go gyeoljeonghae]

INNER PEACE · 내면의 평화
• I breathe, then I soften my gaze. - 숨을 쉬고, 눈빛을 부드럽게 해요.  [sum-eul swi-go, nunbit-eul bu-deureopge hae-yo.]
• I stop chasing, I come back. - 쫓아다니지 않고, 다시 돌아와요.  [jjo-a-da-ni-ji an-go, da-si dol-a-wa-yo.]
• Inhale hope, exhale what ifs. - 숨은 희망으로, 내쉬는 건 걱정이에요.  [sum-eun hui-mang-euro, nae-swi-neun geon geok-jeong-i-e-yo.]
• My heartbeat tells me, calm is here. - 내 심장이 말해요, 여기 평온이 있어요.  [nae sim-jang-i mal-hae-yo, yeo-gi pyeong-on-i is-seo-yo.]
• I untangle one thought at a time. - 생각 하나를, 하나씩 풀어줘요.  [saeng-gak ha-na-reul, ha-na-ssik pul-eo-jwo-yo.]
• I let my body lead today. - 오늘은 몸이 먼저예요.  [o-neul-eun mo-bu i meon-je-ye-yo.]

PURPOSE · 목적
• I do this for a reason - 난 목적이 있어서 하는 거야  [nan MOKjeoki isseo hanun geoya]
• What is your real purpose? - 정말로 하고 싶은 목적이 뭐야?  [jeongmallo hago sipeun MOKjeogi mwoya]
• My purpose is to connect - 제 목적은 사람들과 연결하는 거예요  [je MOKjeun saramdeulgwa yeon-gyeol-haneun geoyeyo]
• I have one clear intention - 나는 딱 하나의 목적이 있어  [nan ttak hanaui MOKjeoki isseo]
• For what purpose is this? - 이거, 어떤 목적으로 하는 거야?  [igeo, eotteon MOKjeokuro haneun geoya]
• Tell me the plan behind it - 왜 하는지 목적부터 말해줘  [wae hanunji MOKjeokbuteo malhaejwo]

CONFIDENCE · 자신감
• I’m ready for this moment - 지금 이 순간을 준비했어요  [ji-geum i sun-gan-eul ju- bi-hae-sseo-yo]
• My voice is worth hearing - 내 목소리는 들을 가치가 있어요  [nae mok-so-neun deur-eul ga-chi-ga i-sseo-yo]
• Pause, then answer calmly - 잠깐 멈추고 차분하게 답해요  [jam- kkan meom-chu-go cha-bun-ha-ge dap-hae-yo]
• I trust what I already know - 내가 이미 아는 걸 믿어요  [nae-ga i-mi a-neun geol mi-deu-eo-yo]
• Even if I stumble, I’ll recover - 넘어져도 다시 일어나면 돼요  [neom-eo- jyeo-do da-si il-eo-na-myeon dwae-yo]
• I’ll ask for clarity when needed - 모르면 알아들을 때까지 물어볼게요  [mo-reu-myeon a-raa-deu-eul ttaek-kka-ji mu-l eo-bol-ge-yo]

PATIENCE · 인내심
• Stay calm when plans change. - 계획이 바뀌어도, 마음은 차분히.  [Gyehoeg-i bakkwieodo, maeumeun chabunhi.]
• Pause, then answer when ready. - 준비될 때 답하면 돼요, 잠깐만 멈춰요.  [Junbwi-doel ttae dabeumyeon dwaeyo, jamkkkan man meomchwo-yo.]
• Give your future self room. - 지금은 미래의 나한테 여유를 줘요.  [Jigeumeun mire-eui nahan테 yeoyureul jwoyo.]
• Keep going, even slowly. - 느려도 괜찮아요, 계속 가요.  [Neuryeodo gwaenchanh-a-yo, gyesok gayo.]
• Let silence cool the tension. - 말을 멈추고, 긴장부터 식혀요.  [Mareul meomchugo, jinjangbuteo si-khyeo-yo.]

CELEBRATIONS & PARTIES · 축하 및 파티
• Cheers, you did it, wow! - 건배, 해냈다, 와!  [geon-bae, hae-nat-da, wa!]
• Happy anniversary, we’re so lucky. - 결혼기념일 축하해요, 정말 행운이에요.  [gyeol-hon-gi-nyeom-il chuk-ha-hae-yo, jeong-mal haeng-un-i-e-yo.]
• Congrats on the new baby. - 아기 태어난 거 진심으로 축하해요.  [a-gi tae-eo-nan geu jin-sim-eu-ro chuk-ha-hae-yo.]
• Welcome to the team, celebrate! - 팀에 오신 걸 환영해요, 축하해요!  [teim-e o-sin geol hwan-yeong-hae-yo, chuk-ha-hae-yo!]
• You deserve this, tonight we celebrate. - 당신이 받을 만해요, 오늘 밤은 파티예요.  [dang-sin-i bal-bul man-hae-yo, o-neul bam-eun pa-ti-ye-yo.]
